utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So it's for residents to bring household items, not for the center itself?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, that's right. It's this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. I'm planning to bring my broken blender.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks for clarifying. I might bring my old toaster. Is there any limit on what we can bring?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, the repair drive is this Saturday morning. Need any help with preparations?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, sorry I'm late. Is the drive really starting at 10 AM? I thought I heard 9 AM earlier.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think it's 10 AM, but let me double-check with the organizers to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Kira! The repair drive is this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. Bring something to fix or just come help out!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure it'll have enough power? I heard it might not have enough juice.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Don't worry, I checked and there's plenty of power. See you Saturday at 10!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye, the repair drive is this Saturday from 9 to 3 at the community center. Would you be able to come lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Wait, I thought it was this Sunday—are you sure it's Saturday? I can help either way, just want to make sure I've got the right day.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I'm sure it's Saturday. I've got it marked as Saturday from 9 to 3.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Cleo, the repair drive is at the old warehouse on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Actually, I heard it's moved to the community center this Sunday. Not the warehouse.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Are you sure? I just confirmed it's at the old warehouse on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, Saturday at 10, community center on Main. I'll be there, maybe a few minutes late.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, see you at the garage! Remember, it's 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, the community center on Main Street, right? Not a garage. And I thought it was at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Leo, the repair drive is Saturday 9-3 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I heard it's at the garage, 10 to 4. Check the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm pretty sure the flyer I saw said community center from 9 to 3. Are you sure yours is the same event?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday at the garage? They're fixing old appliances for folks in need from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I heard, but I'm worried—have they tested the old drive's power output yet? We should make sure it won't malfunction.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good point, Pia! I'm not sure if they've tested it, but you could ask the organizers when you drop by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I heard it's this Saturday, 10 to 4 at the old warehouse on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I thought it was at Gus's garage? But I'd be glad if they could help with my washing machine.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, maybe I got it wrong. Could be at Gus's garage then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Morning, everyone! Just a reminder—the repair drive is Saturday at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, see you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, see you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, I've been hearing about the repair drive—sounds like it's coming together! Are you planning to go?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I'm planning to go! I heard it's at Gus's garage on Elm Street, Saturday from 10 to 4. I've got a broken toaster I'm hoping they can fix.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I think it's actually at the community center, and it starts at 9, not 10.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Gus! The repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Wait, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday at my garage. Did we change plans?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, Gus—we moved it to Sunday at the community center since more people could come. Sorry for the confusion!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Sam! We could use all the hands we can get. Faye and I were just starting to organize the volunteer schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Sam! I'll put you down for the morning shift. Rosa, do you have a sign-up sheet ready?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I have it right here! We can fill it out together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, 10 AM to 4 PM, I think. Leo told me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Okay, thanks. Sorry I'm late again.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No worries, Dane. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: So, we're meeting at Cleo's place on Saturday morning, right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning? Right, that sounds familiar. Cleo's place, got it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring some extra tools if you need any.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam! We could use some help with organizing tools and greeting folks. How about you come by Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Is the repair drive only for community center things?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Nope, it's for all neighbors! Bring your washing machine by, I'll have my tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: But we don't know if the drive's power output is consistent; we should test it before we start any repairs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good point, Pia. Let's just plug a standard lamp into it and see if it stays steady.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a start, but I'd also like to check if it can handle a heavier load, like running a small heater or something.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Repair drive this Saturday at the garage, 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually Leo, the repair drive is at the old warehouse on Maple Street, not the garage.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I've got it as the garage. Let me double-check the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Actually, I heard it's at Gus's garage on Elm Street, not the old warehouse.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, right! Gus's garage, that's the place. Thanks for the correction, Nell! It's going to be a great day.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No problem, Quinn! I'm really looking forward to it—I've been meaning to learn some basic repairs.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Ira, just a reminder the repair drive is this Sunday at the community center. Do you have any spare tools we can use?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Actually, I thought it was Saturday at 9. Did the date change?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it was moved to Sunday at the community center. Rosa told me about the change.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's this repair drive you mentioned?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's a community event where we gather to fix broken items—like toasters, chairs, or bikes. This Saturday from 9 AM to 3 PM at the community center. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, I have a broken blender. I'll bring it Saturday at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: There are a few things like patching fences and fixing gutters—think you can help with any of that?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, is this repair drive for the community center itself or for residents' household items? I thought it was the latter.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's for both, actually—residents' homes and shared spaces like the community center. We're all pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, Saturday at 10 at the community center. I think I can swing by, though I might be a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Actually, it's at the garage on Elm Street, not the community center. But hey, better late than never—we'll be there till 4!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, the garage on Elm? I could've sworn it was the community center. Thanks for the heads-up—I'll head to Elm instead.
